CalculateField building_footprint_HS estimate_h estimate_height(!HTD_SQ_FT!, !Shape_Area!, !HTDSQFTSRC!) PYTHON3 "def estimate_height(htd_sqft, area, src): # Default: 1 story stories = 1.0
# Only trust the ratio when heated sq ft wasn't just copied from the footprint (source 4000) if str(src).strip() != "4000" and htd_sqft and area and area > 0: ratio = float(htd_sqft) / float(area) if ratio >= 1.25: stories = round(ratio * 2) / 2.0 # nearest half story stories = min(stories, 4.0) # cap outliers
height_ft = stories * 10 + 5 # 10 ft per floor + ~5 ft roof return round(height_ft * 0.3048, 2) # metres, for Cesium

dataIdInfo.idAbs: This building footprint dataset was created from the 2020 orthoimagery project and should be considered current only for 2020. The 2020 cycle of the Statewide Ortho project includes 27 coastal counties.It was heads up digitized based on aerials and was QCed last in the summer of 2022This dataset is a collection of polygons representing the roof line of built structures as seen on the 2020 aerials. It was created from several other sources including the 2021 statewide risk dataset.It only includes structures that are over 800 square feet and is intended to only include primary structures that house people for living or working. Garage structures that are just over 800 square feet maybe omitted if they were clearly out buildings.
